description: GENERAL CROSS-OBJECT GENERATOR CODEBOOK (recognize-or-mint). The generic order-N loop (time_axis / TimeInfer) mints a SEPARATE latent:time generator per motion Observation with NO cross-object recognition (two identical-acceleration falls mint two identical LatentDimension nodes -- measured). This seed adds the missing piece: a codebook recognize-or-mint over ANY order-N motion generator, keyed on the generator SIGNATURE (coeffs). It is the exact structural analog of gap_awareness's blessed general dedup retire_duplicate_gap (which dedups SelfConcern by content via Argmin-survivor + identity-Eq): here the content is the whole finite-difference coefficient vector (coeffs) and the partition is an OPAQUE channel tag (motion_kind) the world stamps on each observation it wants indexed (gen_track=1). The rules NEVER mention acceleration/gravity/mass/fall -- they dedup any order-N generator by its signature within its channel. Consequence for the equivalence-principle experiment (GALILEO_EQUIVALENCE_PREREG.md): in the real world every object falls at the SAME acceleration -> identical coeffs -> exactly ONE MotionGenerator{kind=fall} minted and recognized across all N objects; in the Aristotle control (heavier falls faster) the accelerations DIFFER -> N distinct MotionGenerators. 'One generator across objects of measured-different MassScalar' IS acc-perp-mass, read from the graph -- no seeded acc==acc law, no published mass, grouping by perceived Region.

microtheory.name: motion_generator_codebook
microtheory.description: recognize-or-mint over order-N motion generators keyed on the coeffs signature within an opaque channel; the survivor mints one MotionGenerator, every same-signature peer is recognized against it

rules.name: stamp_motion_gen
rules.comment: Mechanical projection: copy the minted latent:time generator's coeffs/order onto its Observation (gen_sig/gen_order) so the codebook rules can group by signature without re-traversing the has_latent_dimension edge inside an Argmin/Filter. Fires once per indexed observation (gen_track==1, status time_inferred, latent:time dimension, not yet stamped).

rules.name: motion_gen_mint
rules.comment: The Argmin SURVIVOR of the set of same-channel (motion_kind), same-signature (gen_sig) indexed observations mints exactly ONE MotionGenerator{sig, kind, order}. Argmin (lowest node id, value=self, the retire_duplicate_gap idiom) makes the survivor UNIQUE, so the mint is race-free even though all peers match in one fixpoint pass. Guarded by Not Exists a MotionGenerator with this sig+kind (fixpoint safety: once minted, never re-mints). Marks the survivor generator_status=minted.

rules.name: motion_gen_recognize
rules.comment: Every NON-survivor indexed observation (not the Argmin survivor of its same-channel same-signature set) is RECOGNIZED against the shared generator its survivor minted -- marked generator_status=recognized, no new node. This is the 'recognize it for every subsequent object' half: N objects of one generator => 1 minted + (N-1) recognized. The Filter/Argmin is identical to motion_gen_mint's, so survivor and recognitions are consistent and the fixpoint terminates (generator_status is not in the filter, so Argmin is stable across passes).
